📣 XCPETS UPDATE 1/4: the GEAR FORGE is open 🔨{chad}

Got a mountain of gear just sitting in your closet doing NOTHING? Not anymore.

⚡ Gear up for real: one burn puts your best spare pieces on your pets ON-CHAIN, strongest pets first. It counts in fights now. A pet never gets a worse piece than it already wears.
💥 Smash: melt spare junk into Gear Dust (Common 1, Uncommon 3, Rare 9, Legendary 27). One copy of every piece is always kept.
🧪 Fuse: 3 copies of a piece become 1 piece one rarity UP.
🎲 Dust roll: 100 Dust = a free gear roll for any pet.

Each one is a tiny 1-dander burn. Your pets have been fighting naked. Fix that 😤

📍 xcpets.fun → Rare Room → Closet → Gear Forge
